Right you are.

Card texts:

Might Of The Camarilla Worth 1 vote. Called by any Justicar or Inner Circle
member at +1 stealth. If this referendum is successful, each Methuselah
chooses one vampire in his or her uncontrolled region and burns him or her.

Goodnight, Sweet Prince Only usable if you have at least one untapped Ravnos
in play. Tap one of your Ravnos. Move the next vampire in the crypt of any
Methuselah to that Methuselah's ash heap. If the vampire you place in the ash
heap is a Prince, gain 2 pool.

Sabbat Inquisitor Worth 1 Vote. Called by any Archbishop or Cardinal at +1
stealth. Choose any Sabbat vampire who is not an Inquisitor. Successful
referendum means that vampire is an Inquisitor; put this card on that
vampire. He or she gets +1 bleed on each bleed action. As a (D) action, he or
she may look at the top vampire of any Methuselah's crypt; if that vampire
has Thaumaturgy, burn that card. This card can be burned with a successful
referendum called by any Sabbat vampire at +1 stealth.

Redeem The Lost Soul Choose a vampire in your ash heap. Gain X pool, where X
is half of the blood capacity of that vampire (round down). Remove that
vampire from the game.

Burned cards are put in the ash heap (Rulebook 1.1.2), which is targeted by
Redeem The Lost Soul.

Wow, talk about a cheap pool gain - get a sabbat inquisitor, load up
with expensive thau vamps in your crypt, burn a couple, get 4 - 5 pool
back every turn at no cost! Great for Anarch Revolt decks, since it is
less risky than getting bloat off a vampire and you still hurt everyone.

Even funnier if you can get away with a few Might of the Camerilla
votes! Everyone loses vamps from their uncontrolled region, but only
you get any benefit from it (via Redeem...).

This is so stupid it might just work...

Messages.Author: hamd...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
> But you would need the Prince of Paris and one Justicar or preferably
Inner
> Circle Member (for really effective Protect Thine Own). And actually
what do
> you want Francois for?

Clan: Toreador
Capacity: 10

Title: Prince of Paris

Ability: Francois may steal up to 2 blood from a younger vampire as a
+1 stealth (D) action. +1 bleed.

Basically, he steals their blood so that even if you you haven't got
the Might of the Camerillas in your hand, you can still cause enough
trouble through banishments (maybe hold them off a turn until you do
have them). In the worst case, he is a great voter with relevant skills
(obf, PRE) and +1 Bleed.

Just banish and call Might... Biggest problem I see is
> that everybody you are targeting will start to eat through their
crypt really
> fast, bringing an new vampire into their uncontrolled region every
turn as
> fodder for the Might.

Burning a blood every turn, and using up all their transfers. If you
are burning / banishing vamps, that could clog up the whole table
easily. Even better with Leondro, since everyone else has to pay extra
to bring out vampires. Only those with lots of Effective Managements
are going to survive.

> Also the Mark Of The Damned thing can be a bit tricky, because
everybody who
> has uncontrolled vampires burns them.

True, but it could get you an oust if you are lucky and bloating
correctly. Safer to use bloat votes instead (Political Stranglehold,
Ancient Influece, con boons. etc).
